messages:
olivia: Heads-up: sample-app CI failing in integration matrix for python-sdk after recent typegen regen.

pete: error shows AuthRetry signature mismatch between published python sdk and new generated types.

ci-bot: build 5177 failed at job 'integration/sample-app:python3.10'.

ci-bot: ```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/workspace/sample_app/start.py", line 8, in <module>
    client = SDK(auth=AuthConfig(retry_policy={}))
TypeError: __init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'retry_policy'
```

typegen-bot: regen summary: packages/typegen/out/auth.pyi updated. Field renamed 'retryPolicy' -> 'retry_policy' to match upstream proto (snake_case). Noted as breaking for Python runtime.

olivia: hmm Python SDK expected camelCase retryPolicy. JS SDK still exposes camelCase. So we have a cross-SDK parity problem (typegen normalization applied only to Python outputs).

opsia: how did the normalizer run selectively? The regen job has per-language transforms; someone changed python transform config last week.

kai: immediate options: revert python transform change, or publish a patch in python sdk that accepts both forms (compat shim). Revert will be fastest to restore CI.

pete: revert PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/typegen/pull/303 (undo python snake_case normalizer). Also adding unit test to prevent regressions.

olivia: while revert lands, can we add small constructor shim in python sdk that maps retry_policy -> retryPolicy? That will reduce customer breakage if a release slipped.

kai: I pushed a quick shim branch with unit tests. Will open PR to python-sdk repo.

typegen-bot: suggested local repro: `yarn workspace @redwood/typegen run regen:python && tox -e py310 -- sample_app/tests/test_start.py`.

pete: also discovered changelog generator omitted this change because commit used 'chore(typegen): normalize names'. We should treat any typegen changes touching public typings as 'semver:major' until validated.

olivia: agreed. Add a rule in release tooling to flag typegen commits that change exported names and require manual semver label.

opsia: created ticket DEVEX-310: "typegen per-language transforms must preserve public naming parity; require semver label on exported name changes". Assigned to devex.

ci-bot: PR 303 checks passed and merged. PR in python-sdk with shim merged as well (patch release requested).

kai: publishing python-sdk patch now (0.9.5 -> 0.9.6). Will run post-release sample-app smoke tests against published wheel.

pete: afterwards, let's add a CI matrix job that runs sample-app against the published package for all official SDKs (js, python, go).

olivia: good plan. Closing thread once post-release checks pass. Thanks for quick triage. :thumbsup:
